Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — proposed times

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the chat last week — excited to show Acme Cloud how Redwood can reduce inference cost and stabilize latency for your generative search use case. Attached a short deck so you and the team can skim before the demo.

I have availability next week: Tue (11/11) 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed (11/12) 14:00-14:45 PT. If neither works, happy to push to the week after.

Agenda: quick intro (5m), live demo (20m), Q&A + next steps (5-10m).

Thanks,

(rachel.kim@redwood.ai)

Would you be open to moving this to the week of Dec 1, so we can get the full team? If you have any availability Dec 1-5, please send a couple of slots and we’ll lock it in.

Alex

alex.jensen@acmecloud.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Thanks for the heads up, Alex — totally understand. Dec 1-5 works for us. Suggested slots:
- Mon, Dec 1 | 09:00-09:45 PT
- Tue, Dec 2 | 11:00-11:45 PT
- Thu, Dec 4 | 14:00-14:45 PT

Stephanie will lead the product demo; Marissa will cover deployment and SSO questions. Can you confirm which stakeholders you want on the call so we tailor the demo?

Best,
